ar: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ حمٓ
tr: Ḥā mīm

ar: تَنزِيلُ ٱلْكِتَٰبِ مِنَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْعَلِيمِ
en: (2) The revelation of the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] is from Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Knowing,
tr: Tanzīlul-kitābi minallāhil-ʿazīzil-ʿalīm

ar: غَافِرِ ٱلذَّنۢبِ وَقَابِلِ ٱلتَّوْبِ شَدِيدِ ٱلْعِقَابِ ذِى ٱلطَّوْلِ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلْمَصِيرُ
en: (3) The forgiver of sin, acceptor of repentance, severe in punishment, owner of abundance. There is no deity except Him; to Him is the destination.
tr: Ghāfiridh-dhambi waqābilit-tawbi shadīdil-ʿiqābi dhiṭ-ṭawl, lā ilāha illā huw, ilayhil-maṣīr

ar: مَا يُجَٰدِلُ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ إِلَّا ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ فَلَا يَغْرُرْكَ تَقَلُّبُهُمْ فِى ٱلْبِلَٰدِ
en: (4) No one disputes concerning the signs of Allāh except those who disbelieve, so be not deceived by their [uninhibited] movement throughout the land.
tr: Mā yujādilu fī āyātillāhi illal-ladhīna kafarū falā yaghrurka taqallubuhum fil-bilād

ar: كَذَّبَتْ قَبْلَهُمْ قَوْمُ نُوحٍ وَٱلْأَحْزَابُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ وَهَمَّتْ كُلُّ أُمَّةٍۭ بِرَسُولِهِمْ لِيَأْخُذُوهُ وَجَٰدَلُوا۟ بِٱلْبَٰطِلِ لِيُدْحِضُوا۟ بِهِ ٱلْحَقَّ فَأَخَذْتُهُمْ فَكَيْفَ كَانَ عِقَابِ
en: (5) The people of Noah denied before them and the [disbelieving] factions after them, and every nation intended [a plot] for their messenger to seize him, and they disputed by [using] falsehood to [attempt to] invalidate thereby the truth. So I seized them, and how [terrible] was My penalty.
tr: Kadhdhabat qablahum qawmu nūḥiw wal-aḥzābu mim baʿdihim, wahammat kullu ummatim birasūlihim liyaʾkhudhūhu wajādalū bil-bāṭili liyudḥiḍū bihil-ḥaqqa faʾakhadhtuhum, fakayfa kāna ʿiqāb

ar: وَكَذَٰلِكَ حَقَّتْ كَلِمَتُ رَبِّكَ عَلَى ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَنَّهُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
en: (6) And thus has the word [i.e., decree] of your Lord come into effect upon those who disbelieved that they are companions of the Fire.
tr: Wakadhālika ḥaqqat kalimatu rabbika ʿalal-ladhīna kafarū annahum aṣḥābun-nār

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يَحْمِلُونَ ٱلْعَرْشَ وَمَنْ حَوْلَهُۥ يُسَبِّحُونَ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّهِمْ وَيُؤْمِنُونَ بِهِۦ وَيَسْتَغْفِرُونَ لِلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ رَبَّنَا وَسِعْتَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ رَّحْمَةً وَعِلْمًا فَٱغْفِرْ لِلَّذِينَ تَابُوا۟ وَٱتَّبَعُوا۟ سَبِيلَكَ وَقِهِمْ عَذَابَ ٱلْجَحِيمِ
en: (7) Those [angels] who carry the Throne and those around it exalt [Allāh] with praise of their Lord and believe in Him and ask forgiveness for those who have believed, [saying], "Our Lord, You have encompassed all things in mercy and knowledge, so forgive those who have repented and followed Your way and protect them from the punishment of Hellfire.
tr: Alladhīna yaḥmilūnal-ʿarsha waman ḥawlahū yusabbiḥūna biḥamdi rabbihim wayuʾminūna bihī wayastaghfirūna lilladhīna āmanū, rabbanā wasiʿta kulla shayʾir raḥmataw waʿilman faghfir lilladhīna tābū wattabaʿū sabīlaka waqihim ʿadhābal-jaḥīm

ar: رَبَّنَا وَأَدْخِلْهُمْ جَنَّٰتِ عَدْنٍ ٱلَّتِى وَعَدتَّهُمْ وَمَن صَلَحَ مِنْ ءَابَآئِهِمْ وَأَزْوَٰجِهِمْ وَذُرِّيَّٰتِهِمْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْعَزِيزُ ٱلْحَكِيمُ
en: (8) Our Lord, and admit them to gardens of perpetual residence which You have promised them and whoever was righteous among their forefathers, their spouses and their offspring. Indeed, it is You who is the Exalted in Might, the Wise.
tr: Rabbanā waʾadkhilhum jannāti ʿadninil-latī waʿattahum waman ṣalaḥa min ābāʾihim waʾazwājihim wadhurriyyātihim, innaka antal-ʿazīzul-ḥakīm

ar: وَقِهِمُ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ وَمَن تَقِ ٱلسَّيِّـَٔاتِ يَوْمَئِذٍ فَقَدْ رَحِمْتَهُۥ وَذَٰلِكَ هُوَ ٱلْفَوْزُ ٱلْعَظِيمُ
en: (9) And protect them from the evil consequences [of their deeds]. And he whom You protect from evil consequences that Day - You will have given him mercy. And that is the great attainment."
tr: Waqihimus-sayyiʾāt, waman taqis-sayyiʾāti yawmaʾidhin faqad raḥimtah, wadhālika huwal-fawzul-ʿaẓīm

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوا۟ يُنَادَوْنَ لَمَقْتُ ٱللَّهِ أَكْبَرُ مِن مَّقْتِكُمْ أَنفُسَكُمْ إِذْ تُدْعَوْنَ إِلَى ٱلْإِيمَٰنِ فَتَكْفُرُونَ
en: (10) Indeed, those who disbelieve will be addressed, "The hatred of Allāh for you was [even] greater than your hatred of yourselves [this Day in Hell] when you were invited to faith, but you disbelieved [i.e., refused]."
tr: Innal-ladhīna kafarū yunādawna lamaqtullāhi akbaru mim maqtikum anfusakum idh tudʿawna ilal-īmāni fatakfurūn

ar: قَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَآ أَمَتَّنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ وَأَحْيَيْتَنَا ٱثْنَتَيْنِ فَٱعْتَرَفْنَا بِذُنُوبِنَا فَهَلْ إِلَىٰ خُرُوجٍ مِّن سَبِيلٍ
en: (11) They will say, "Our Lord, You made us lifeless twice and gave us life twice, and we have confessed our sins. So is there to an exit any way?"
tr: Qālū rabbanā amattanathnatayni waʾaḥyaytanathnatayni faʿtarafnā bidhunūbinā fahal ilā khurūjim min sabīl

ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِأَنَّهُۥٓ إِذَا دُعِىَ ٱللَّهُ وَحْدَهُۥ كَفَرْتُمْ وَإِن يُشْرَكْ بِهِۦ تُؤْمِنُوا۟ فَٱلْحُكْمُ لِلَّهِ ٱلْعَلِىِّ ٱلْكَبِيرِ
en: (12) [They will be told], "That is because, when Allāh was called upon alone, you disbelieved; but if others were associated with Him, you believed. So the judgement is with Allāh, the Most High, the Grand."
tr: Dhālikum biʾannahū idhā duʿiyallāhu waḥdahū kafartum, waʾiy yushrak bihī tuʾminū, fal-ḥukmu lillāhil-ʿaliyyil-kabīr

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ وَيُنَزِّلُ لَكُم مِّنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ رِزْقًا وَمَا يَتَذَكَّرُ إِلَّا مَن يُنِيبُ
en: (13) It is He who shows you His signs and sends down to you from the sky, provision. But none will remember except he who turns back [in repentance].
tr: Huwal-ladhī yurīkum āyātihī wayunazzilu lakum minas-samāʾi rizqā, wamā yatadhakkaru illā may yunīb

ar: فَٱدْعُوا۟ ٱللَّهَ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ وَلَوْ كَرِهَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
en: (14) So invoke Allāh, [being] sincere to Him in religion, although the disbelievers dislike it.
tr: Fadʿullāha mukhliṣīna lahud-dīna walaw karihal-kāfirūn

ar: رَفِيعُ ٱلدَّرَجَٰتِ ذُو ٱلْعَرْشِ يُلْقِى ٱلرُّوحَ مِنْ أَمْرِهِۦ عَلَىٰ مَن يَشَآءُ مِنْ عِبَادِهِۦ لِيُنذِرَ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّلَاقِ
en: (15) [He is] the Exalted above [all] degrees, Owner of the Throne; He places the inspiration of His command [i.e., revelation] upon whom He wills of His servants to warn of the Day of Meeting.
tr: Rafīʿud-darajāti dhul-ʿarsh, yulqir-rūḥa min amrihī ʿalā may yashāʾu min ʿibādihī liyundhira yawmat-talāq

ar: يَوْمَ هُم بَٰرِزُونَ لَا يَخْفَىٰ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ مِنْهُمْ شَىْءٌ لِّمَنِ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ لِلَّهِ ٱلْوَٰحِدِ ٱلْقَهَّارِ
en: (16) The Day they come forth nothing concerning them will be concealed from Allāh. To whom belongs [all] sovereignty this Day? To Allāh, the One, the Prevailing.[1365]
tr: Yawma hum bārizūn, lā yakhfā ʿalallāhi minhum shayʾ, limanil-mulkul-yawm, lillāhil-wāḥidil-qahhār

ar: ٱلْيَوْمَ تُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا كَسَبَتْ لَا ظُلْمَ ٱلْيَوْمَ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ سَرِيعُ ٱلْحِسَابِ
en: (17) This Day every soul will be recompensed for what it earned. No injustice today! Indeed, Allāh is swift in account.
tr: Al-yawma tujzā kullu nafsim bimā kasabat, lā ẓulmal-yawm, innallāha sarīʿul-ḥisāb

ar: وَأَنذِرْهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْـَٔازِفَةِ إِذِ ٱلْقُلُوبُ لَدَى ٱلْحَنَاجِرِ كَٰظِمِينَ مَا لِلظَّٰلِمِينَ مِنْ حَمِيمٍ وَلَا شَفِيعٍ يُطَاعُ
en: (18) And warn them, [O Muḥammad], of the Approaching Day, when hearts are at the throats, filled [with distress]. For the wrongdoers there will be no devoted friend and no intercessor [who is] obeyed.
tr: Waʾandhirhum yawmal-āzifati idhil-qulūbu ladal-ḥanājiri kāẓimīn, mā liẓ-ẓālimīna min ḥamīmiw walā shafīʿiy yuṭāʿ

ar: يَعْلَمُ خَآئِنَةَ ٱلْأَعْيُنِ وَمَا تُخْفِى ٱلصُّدُورُ
en: (19) He knows that which deceives the eyes and what the breasts conceal.
tr: Yaʿlamu khāʾinatal-aʿyuni wamā tukhfiṣ-ṣudūr

ar: وَٱللَّهُ يَقْضِى بِٱلْحَقِّ وَٱلَّذِينَ يَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِهِۦ لَا يَقْضُونَ بِشَىْءٍ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
en: (20) And Allāh judges with truth, while those they invoke[1366] besides Him judge not with anything. Indeed, Allāh - He is the Hearing, the Seeing.
tr: Wallāhu yaqḍī bil-ḥaqq, wal-ladhīna yadʿūna min dūnihī lā yaqḍūna bishayʾ, innallāha huwas-samīʿul-baṣīr

ar: أَوَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوا۟ هُمْ أَشَدَّ مِنْهُمْ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ بِذُنُوبِهِمْ وَمَا كَانَ لَهُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِن وَاقٍ
en: (21) Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those who were before them? They were greater than them in strength and in impression on the land, but Allāh seized them for their sins. And they had not from Allāh any protector.
tr: Awalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatul-ladhīna kānū min qablihim, kānū hum ashadda minhum quwwataw waʾāthāran fil-arḍi faʾakhadhahumullāhu bidhunūbihim, wamā kāna lahum minallāhi miw wāq

ar: ذَٰلِكَ بِأَنَّهُمْ كَانَت تَّأْتِيهِمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَكَفَرُوا۟ فَأَخَذَهُمُ ٱللَّهُ إِنَّهُۥ قَوِىٌّ شَدِيدُ ٱلْعِقَابِ
en: (22) That was because their messengers were coming to them with clear proofs, but they disbelieved, so Allāh seized them. Indeed, He is Powerful and severe in punishment.
tr: Dhālika biʾannahum kānat taʾtīhim rusuluhum bil-bayyināti fakafarū faʾakhadhahumullāh, innahū qawiyyun shadīdul-ʿiqāb

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا مُوسَىٰ بِـَٔايَٰتِنَا وَسُلْطَٰنٍ مُّبِينٍ
en: (23) And We did certainly send Moses with Our signs and a clear authority[1367]
tr: Walaqad arsalnā mūsā biʾāyātinā wasulṭānim mubīn

ar: إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ وَهَٰمَٰنَ وَقَٰرُونَ فَقَالُوا۟ سَٰحِرٌ كَذَّابٌ
en: (24) To Pharaoh, Hāmān and Qārūn, but they said, "[He is] a magician and a liar."
tr: Ilā firʿawna wahāmāna waqārūna faqālū sāḥirun kadhdhāb

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَهُم بِٱلْحَقِّ مِنْ عِندِنَا قَالُوا۟ ٱقْتُلُوٓا۟ أَبْنَآءَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ مَعَهُۥ وَٱسْتَحْيُوا۟ نِسَآءَهُمْ وَمَا كَيْدُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ
en: (25) And when he brought them the truth from Us, they said, "Kill the sons of those who have believed with him and keep their women alive." But the plan of the disbelievers is not except in error.
tr: Falammā jāʾahum bil-ḥaqqi min ʿindinā qāluqtulū abnāʾal-ladhīna āmanū maʿahū wastaḥyū nisāʾahum, wamā kaydul-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalāl

ar: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ ذَرُونِىٓ أَقْتُلْ مُوسَىٰ وَلْيَدْعُ رَبَّهُۥٓ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ أَن يُبَدِّلَ دِينَكُمْ أَوْ أَن يُظْهِرَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ ٱلْفَسَادَ
en: (26) And Pharaoh said, "Let me kill Moses and let him call upon his Lord. Indeed, I fear that he will change your religion or that he will cause corruption[1368] in the land."
tr: Waqāla firʿawnu dharūnī aqtul mūsā walyadʿu rabbah, innī akhāfu ay yubaddila dīnakum aw ay yuẓhira fil-arḍil-fasād

ar: وَقَالَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِنِّى عُذْتُ بِرَبِّى وَرَبِّكُم مِّن كُلِّ مُتَكَبِّرٍ لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِيَوْمِ ٱلْحِسَابِ
en: (27) But Moses said, "Indeed, I have sought refuge in my Lord and your Lord from every arrogant one who does not believe in the Day of Account."
tr: Waqāla mūsā innī ʿudhtu birabbī warabbikum min kulli mutakabbiril lā yuʾminu biyawmil-ḥisāb

ar: وَقَالَ رَجُلٌ مُّؤْمِنٌ مِّنْ ءَالِ فِرْعَوْنَ يَكْتُمُ إِيمَٰنَهُۥٓ أَتَقْتُلُونَ رَجُلًا أَن يَقُولَ رَبِّىَ ٱللَّهُ وَقَدْ جَآءَكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ مِن رَّبِّكُمْ وَإِن يَكُ كَٰذِبًا فَعَلَيْهِ كَذِبُهُۥ وَإِن يَكُ صَادِقًا يُصِبْكُم بَعْضُ ٱلَّذِى يَعِدُكُمْ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَا يَهْدِى مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ كَذَّابٌ
en: (28) And a believing man from the family of Pharaoh who concealed his faith said, "Do you kill a man [merely] because he says, 'My Lord is Allāh' while he has brought you clear proofs from your Lord? And if he should be lying, then upon him is [the consequence of] his lie; but if he should be truthful, there will strike you some of what he promises you. Indeed, Allāh does not guide one who is a transgressor and a liar.
tr: Waqāla rajulum muʾmin, min āli firʿawna yaktumu īmānahū ataqtulūna rajulan ay yaqūla rabbiyallāhu waqad jāʾakum bil-bayyināti mir rabbikum, waʾiy yaku kādhiban faʿalayhi kadhibuh, waʾiy yaku ṣādiqay yuṣibkum baʿḍul-ladhī yaʿidukum, innallāha lā yahdī man huwa musrifun kadhdhāb

ar: يَٰقَوْمِ لَكُمُ ٱلْمُلْكُ ٱلْيَوْمَ ظَٰهِرِينَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَن يَنصُرُنَا مِنۢ بَأْسِ ٱللَّهِ إِن جَآءَنَا قَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ مَآ أُرِيكُمْ إِلَّا مَآ أَرَىٰ وَمَآ أَهْدِيكُمْ إِلَّا سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
en: (29) O my people, sovereignty is yours today, [your being] dominant in the land. But who would protect us from the punishment of Allāh if it came to us?" Pharaoh said, "I do not show you except what I see, and I do not guide you except to the way of right conduct."
tr: Yāqawmi lakumul-mulkul-yawma ẓāhirīna fil-arḍ, famay yanṣurunā mim baʾsillāhi in jāʾanā, qāla firʿawnu mā urīkum illā mā arā wamā ahdīkum illā sabīlar-rashād

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُم مِّثْلَ يَوْمِ ٱلْأَحْزَابِ
en: (30) And he who believed said, "O my people, indeed I fear for you [a fate] like the day of the companies[1369] -
enNotes: [1369]- i.e., the days on which Allāh sent His punishment upon those who rejected their prophets in former times.
tr: Waqālal-ladhī āmana yāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum mithla yawmil-aḥzāb

ar: مِثْلَ دَأْبِ قَوْمِ نُوحٍ وَعَادٍ وَثَمُودَ وَٱلَّذِينَ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِمْ وَمَا ٱللَّهُ يُرِيدُ ظُلْمًا لِّلْعِبَادِ
en: (31) Like the custom of the people of Noah and of ʿAad and Thamūd and those after them. And Allāh wants no injustice for [His] servants.
tr: Mithla daʾbi qawmi nūḥiw waʿādiw wathamūda wal-ladhīna mim baʿdihim, wamallāhu yurīdu ẓulmal lil-ʿibād

ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ إِنِّىٓ أَخَافُ عَلَيْكُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلتَّنَادِ
en: (32) And O my people, indeed I fear for you the Day of Calling[1370] -
enNotes: [1370]- i.e., the Day of Judgement, when the criminals will cry out in terror, the people will call to each other (see 7:44-51), and the angels will call out the results of each person's judgement.
tr: Wayāqawmi innī akhāfu ʿalaykum yawmat-tanād

ar: يَوْمَ تُوَلُّونَ مُدْبِرِينَ مَا لَكُم مِّنَ ٱللَّهِ مِنْ عَاصِمٍ وَمَن يُضْلِلِ ٱللَّهُ فَمَا لَهُۥ مِنْ هَادٍ
en: (33) The Day you will turn your backs fleeing; there is not for you from Allāh any protector. And whoever Allāh sends astray - there is not for him any guide.
tr: Yawma tuwallūna mudbirīn, mā lakum minallāhi min ʿāṣim, wamay yuḍlilillāhu famā lahū min hād

ar: وَلَقَدْ جَآءَكُمْ يُوسُفُ مِن قَبْلُ بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَمَا زِلْتُمْ فِى شَكٍّ مِّمَّا جَآءَكُم بِهِۦ حَتَّىٰٓ إِذَا هَلَكَ قُلْتُمْ لَن يَبْعَثَ ٱللَّهُ مِنۢ بَعْدِهِۦ رَسُولًا كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ مَنْ هُوَ مُسْرِفٌ مُّرْتَابٌ
en: (34) And Joseph had already come to you before with clear proofs, but you remained in doubt of that which he brought to you, until when he died, you said, 'Never will Allāh send a messenger after him.' Thus does Allāh leave astray he who is a transgressor and skeptic."
tr: Walaqad jāʾakum yūsufu min qablu bil-bayyināti famā ziltum fī shakkim mimmā jāʾakum bih, ḥattā idhā halaka qultum lay yabʿathallāhu mim baʿdihī rasūlā, kadhālika yuḍillullāhu man huwa musrifum murtāb

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ كَبُرَ مَقْتًا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ وَعِندَ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ كَذَٰلِكَ يَطْبَعُ ٱللَّهُ عَلَىٰ كُلِّ قَلْبِ مُتَكَبِّرٍ جَبَّارٍ
en: (35) Those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without an authority[1371] having come to them - great is hatred [of them] in the sight of Allāh and in the sight of those who have believed. Thus does Allāh seal over every heart [belonging to] an arrogant tyrant.
tr: Al-ladhīna yujādilūna fī āyātillāhi bighayri sulṭānin atāhum, kabura maqtan ʿindallāhi waʿindal-ladhīna āmanū, kadhālika yaṭbaʿullāhu ʿalā kulli qalbi mutakabbirin jabbār

ar: وَقَالَ فِرْعَوْنُ يَٰهَٰمَٰنُ ٱبْنِ لِى صَرْحًا لَّعَلِّىٓ أَبْلُغُ ٱلْأَسْبَٰبَ
en: (36) And Pharaoh said, "O Hāmān, construct for me a tower that I might reach the ways[1372] -
tr: Waqāla firʿawnu yāhāmānubni lī ṣarḥal laʿallī ablughul-asbāb

ar: أَسْبَٰبَ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ فَأَطَّلِعَ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَٰهِ مُوسَىٰ وَإِنِّى لَأَظُنُّهُۥ كَٰذِبًا وَكَذَٰلِكَ زُيِّنَ لِفِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ عَمَلِهِۦ وَصُدَّ عَنِ ٱلسَّبِيلِ وَمَا كَيْدُ فِرْعَوْنَ إِلَّا فِى تَبَابٍ
en: (37) The ways into the heavens - so that I may look at the deity of Moses; but indeed, I think he is a liar." And thus was made attractive to Pharaoh the evil of his deed, and he was averted from the [right] way. And the plan of Pharaoh was not except in ruin.
tr: Asbābas-samāwāti faʾaṭṭaliʿa ilā ilāhi mūsā waʾinnī laʾaẓunnuhū kādhibā, wakadhālika zuyyina lifirʿawna sūʾu ʿamalihī waṣudda ʿanis-sabīl, wamā kaydu firʿawna illā fī tabāb

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِىٓ ءَامَنَ يَٰقَوْمِ ٱتَّبِعُونِ أَهْدِكُمْ سَبِيلَ ٱلرَّشَادِ
en: (38) And he who believed said, "O my people, follow me; I will guide you to the way of right conduct.
tr: Waqālal-ladhī āmana yāqawmittabiʿūni ahdikum sabīlar-rashād

ar: يَٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا هَٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةُ ٱلدُّنْيَا مَتَٰعٌ وَإِنَّ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةَ هِىَ دَارُ ٱلْقَرَارِ
en: (39) O my people, this worldly life is only [temporary] enjoyment, and indeed, the Hereafter - that is the home of [permanent] settlement.
tr: Yāqawmi innamā hādhihil-ḥayātud-dunyā matāʿ, waʾinnal-ākhirata hiya dārul-qarār

ar: مَنْ عَمِلَ سَيِّئَةً فَلَا يُجْزَىٰٓ إِلَّا مِثْلَهَا وَمَنْ عَمِلَ صَٰلِحًا مِّن ذَكَرٍ أَوْ أُنثَىٰ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌ فَأُو۟لَٰٓئِكَ يَدْخُلُونَ ٱلْجَنَّةَ يُرْزَقُونَ فِيهَا بِغَيْرِ حِسَابٍ
en: (40) Whoever does an evil deed will not be recompensed except by the like thereof; but whoever does righteousness, whether male or female, while he is a believer - those will enter Paradise, being given provision therein without account.
tr: Man ʿamila sayyiʾatan falā yujzā illā mithlahā, waman ʿamila ṣāliḥam min dhakarin aw unthā wahuwa muʾminun faʾulāʾika yadkhulūnal-jannata yurzaqūna fīhā bighayri ḥisāb

ar: وَيَٰقَوْمِ مَا لِىٓ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلنَّجَوٰةِ وَتَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَى ٱلنَّارِ
en: (41) And O my people, how is it that I invite you to salvation while you invite me to the Fire?
tr: Wayāqawmi mā lī adʿūkum ilan-najāti watadʿūnanī ilan-nār

ar: تَدْعُونَنِى لِأَكْفُرَ بِٱللَّهِ وَأُشْرِكَ بِهِۦ مَا لَيْسَ لِى بِهِۦ عِلْمٌ وَأَنَا۠ أَدْعُوكُمْ إِلَى ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْغَفَّٰرِ
en: (42) You invite me to disbelieve in Allāh and associate with Him that of which I have no knowledge, and I invite you to the Exalted in Might, the Perpetual Forgiver.[1373]
tr: Tadʿūnanī liʾakfura billāhi waʾushrika bihī mā laysa lī bihī ʿilmuw waʾana adʿūkum ilal-ʿazīzil-ghaffār

ar: لَا جَرَمَ أَنَّمَا تَدْعُونَنِىٓ إِلَيْهِ لَيْسَ لَهُۥ دَعْوَةٌ فِى ٱلدُّنْيَا وَلَا فِى ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ وَأَنَّ مَرَدَّنَآ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ وَأَنَّ ٱلْمُسْرِفِينَ هُمْ أَصْحَٰبُ ٱلنَّارِ
en: (43) Assuredly, that to which you invite me has no [response to a] supplication in this world or in the Hereafter; and indeed, our return is to Allāh, and indeed, the transgressors will be companions of the Fire.
tr: Lā jarama annamā tadʿūnanī ilayhi laysa lahū daʿwatun fid-dunyā walā fil-ākhirati waʾanna maraddanā ilallāhi waʾannal-musrifīna hum aṣḥābun-nār

ar: فَسَتَذْكُرُونَ مَآ أَقُولُ لَكُمْ وَأُفَوِّضُ أَمْرِىٓ إِلَى ٱللَّهِ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ بَصِيرٌۢ بِٱلْعِبَادِ
en: (44) And you will remember what I [now] say to you, and I entrust my affair to Allāh. Indeed, Allāh is Seeing of [His] servants."
tr: Fasatadhkurūna mā aqūlu lakum, waʾufawwiḍu amrī ilallāh, innallāha baṣīrum bil-ʿibād

ar: فَوَقَىٰهُ ٱللَّهُ سَيِّـَٔاتِ مَا مَكَرُوا۟ وَحَاقَ بِـَٔالِ فِرْعَوْنَ سُوٓءُ ٱلْعَذَابِ
en: (45) So Allāh protected him from the evils they plotted, and the people of Pharaoh were enveloped by the worst of punishment -
tr: Fawaqāhullāhu sayyiʾāti mā makarū waḥāqa biʾāli firʿawna sūʾul-ʿadhāb

ar: ٱلنَّارُ يُعْرَضُونَ عَلَيْهَا غُدُوًّا وَعَشِيًّا وَيَوْمَ تَقُومُ ٱلسَّاعَةُ أَدْخِلُوٓا۟ ءَالَ فِرْعَوْنَ أَشَدَّ ٱلْعَذَابِ
en: (46) The Fire; they are exposed to it morning and evening.[1374] And the Day the Hour appears [it will be said], "Make the people of Pharaoh enter the severest punishment."
enNotes: [1374]- From the time of their death until the Day of Resurrection, when they will be driven into it.
tr: An-nāru yuʿraḍūna ʿalayhā ghuduwwaw waʿashiyyā, wayawma taqūmus-sāʿah, adkhilū āla firʿawna ashaddal-ʿadhāb

ar: وَإِذْ يَتَحَآجُّونَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ فَيَقُولُ ٱلضُّعَفَٰٓؤُا۟ لِلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُنَّا لَكُمْ تَبَعًا فَهَلْ أَنتُم مُّغْنُونَ عَنَّا نَصِيبًا مِّنَ ٱلنَّارِ
en: (47) And [mention] when they will argue within the Fire, and the weak will say to those who had been arrogant, "Indeed, we were [only] your followers, so will you relieve us of a share of the Fire?"
tr: Waʾidh yataḥājjūna fin-nāri fayaqūluḍ-ḍuʿafāʾu lilladhīnastakbarū innā kunnā lakum tabaʿan fahal antum mughnūna ʿannā naṣībam minan-nār

ar: قَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱسْتَكْبَرُوٓا۟ إِنَّا كُلٌّ فِيهَآ إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ قَدْ حَكَمَ بَيْنَ ٱلْعِبَادِ
en: (48) Those who had been arrogant will say, "Indeed, all [of us] are in it. Indeed, Allāh has judged between the servants."
tr: Qālal-ladhīnastakbarū innā kullun fīhā innallāha qad ḥakama baynal-ʿibād

ar: وَقَالَ ٱلَّذِينَ فِى ٱلنَّارِ لِخَزَنَةِ جَهَنَّمَ ٱدْعُوا۟ رَبَّكُمْ يُخَفِّفْ عَنَّا يَوْمًا مِّنَ ٱلْعَذَابِ
en: (49) And those in the Fire will say to the keepers of Hell, "Supplicate your Lord to lighten for us a day from the punishment."
tr: Waqālal-ladhīna fin-nāri likhazanati jahannamadʿū rabbakum yukhaffif ʿannā yawmam minal-ʿadhāb

ar: قَالُوٓا۟ أَوَلَمْ تَكُ تَأْتِيكُمْ رُسُلُكُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ قَالُوا۟ بَلَىٰ قَالُوا۟ فَٱدْعُوا۟ وَمَا دُعَٰٓؤُا۟ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ إِلَّا فِى ضَلَٰلٍ
en: (50) They will say, "Did there not come to you your messengers with clear proofs?" They will say, "Yes." They will reply, "Then supplicate [yourselves], but the supplication of the disbelievers is not except in error [i.e., futility]."
tr: Qālū awalam taku taʾtīkum rusulukum bil-bayyināt, qālū balā, qālū fadʿū, wamā duʿāʾul-kāfirīna illā fī ḍalāl

ar: إِنَّا لَنَنصُرُ رُسُلَنَا وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا وَيَوْمَ يَقُومُ ٱلْأَشْهَٰدُ
en: (51) Indeed, We will support Our messengers and those who believe during the life of this world and on the Day when the witnesses will stand -
tr: Innā lananṣuru rusulanā wal-ladhīna āmanū fil-ḥayātid-dunyā wayawma yaqūmul-ashhād

ar: يَوْمَ لَا يَنفَعُ ٱلظَّٰلِمِينَ مَعْذِرَتُهُمْ وَلَهُمُ ٱللَّعْنَةُ وَلَهُمْ سُوٓءُ ٱلدَّارِ
en: (52) The Day their excuse will not benefit the wrongdoers, and they will have the curse, and they will have the worst home [i.e., Hell].
tr: Yawma lā yanfaʿuẓ-ẓālimīna maʿdhiratuhum walahumul-laʿnatu walahum sūʾud-dār

ar: وَلَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَا مُوسَى ٱلْهُدَىٰ وَأَوْرَثْنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ ٱلْكِتَٰبَ
en: (53) And We had certainly given Moses guidance, and We caused the Children of Israel to inherit the Scripture
tr: Walaqad ātaynā mūsal-hudā waʾawrathnā banī isrāʾīlal-kitāb

ar: هُدًى وَذِكْرَىٰ لِأُو۟لِى ٱلْأَلْبَٰبِ
en: (54) As guidance and a reminder for those of understanding.
tr: Hudaw wadhikrā liʾulil-albāb

ar: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ وَٱسْتَغْفِرْ لِذَنۢبِكَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ بِٱلْعَشِىِّ وَٱلْإِبْكَٰرِ
en: (55) So be patient, [O Muḥammad]. Indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And ask forgiveness for your sin[1375] and exalt [Allāh] with praise of your Lord in the evening and the morning.
enNotes: [1375]- What is intended is "fault" or "error" in judgement, since all prophets were protected by Allāh from falling into sin. The implication is that all believers should seek forgiveness for their sins.
tr: Faṣbir inna waʿdallāhi ḥaqquw wastaghfir lidhambika wasabbiḥ biḥamdi rabbika bil-ʿashiyyi wal-ibkār

ar: إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ بِغَيْرِ سُلْطَٰنٍ أَتَىٰهُمْ إِن فِى صُدُورِهِمْ إِلَّا كِبْرٌ مَّا هُم بِبَٰلِغِيهِ فَٱسْتَعِذْ بِٱللَّهِ إِنَّهُۥ هُوَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلْبَصِيرُ
en: (56) Indeed, those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh without [any] evidence having come to them - there is not within their breasts except pride, [the extent of] which they cannot reach. So seek refuge in Allāh. Indeed, it is He who is the Hearing, the Seeing.
tr: Innal-ladhīna yujādilūna fī āyātillāhi bighayri sulṭānin atāhum in fī ṣudūrihim illā kibrum mā hum bibālighīh, fastaʿidh billāh, innahū huwas-samīʿul-baṣīr

ar: لَخَلْقُ ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلْأَرْضِ أَكْبَرُ مِنْ خَلْقِ ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (57) The creation of the heavens and earth is greater than the creation of mankind, but most of the people do not know.
tr: Lakhalqus-samāwāti wal-arḍi akbaru min khalqin-nāsi walākinna aktharan-nāsi lā yaʿlamūn

ar: وَمَا يَسْتَوِى ٱلْأَعْمَىٰ وَٱلْبَصِيرُ وَٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّٰلِحَٰتِ وَلَا ٱلْمُسِىٓءُ قَلِيلًا مَّا تَتَذَكَّرُونَ
en: (58) And not equal are the blind and the seeing, nor are those who believe and do righteous deeds and the evildoer. Little do you remember.
tr: Wamā yastawil-aʿmā wal-baṣīru wal-ladhīna āmanū waʿamiluṣ-ṣāliḥāti walal-musīʾ, qalīlam mā tatadhakkarūn

ar: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ لَـَٔاتِيَةٌ لَّا رَيْبَ فِيهَا وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يُؤْمِنُونَ
en: (59) Indeed, the Hour is coming - no doubt about it - but most of the people do not believe.
tr: Innas-sāʿata laʾātiyatul lā rayba fīhā, walākinna aktharan-nāsi lā yuʾminūn

ar: وَقَالَ رَبُّكُمُ ٱدْعُونِىٓ أَسْتَجِبْ لَكُمْ إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ يَسْتَكْبِرُونَ عَنْ عِبَادَتِى سَيَدْخُلُونَ جَهَنَّمَ دَاخِرِينَ
en: (60) And your Lord says, "Call upon Me; I will respond to you." Indeed, those who disdain My worship will enter Hell [rendered] contemptible.
tr: Waqāla rabbukumudʿūnī astajib lakum, innal-ladhīna yastakbirūna ʿan ʿibādatī sayadkhulūna jahannama dākhirīn

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلَّيْلَ لِتَسْكُنُوا۟ فِيهِ وَٱلنَّهَارَ مُبْصِرًا إِنَّ ٱللَّهَ لَذُو فَضْلٍ عَلَى ٱلنَّاسِ وَلَٰكِنَّ أَكْثَرَ ٱلنَّاسِ لَا يَشْكُرُونَ
en: (61) It is Allāh who made for you the night that you may rest therein and the day giving sight.[1376] Indeed, Allāh is the possessor of bounty for the people, but most of them are not grateful.
tr: Allāhul-ladhī jaʿala lakumul-layla litaskunū fīhi wan-nahāra mubṣirā, innallāha ladhū faḍlin ʿalan-nāsi walākinna aktharan-nāsi lā yashkurūn

ar: ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ خَٰلِقُ كُلِّ شَىْءٍ لَّآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَأَنَّىٰ تُؤْفَكُونَ
en: (62) That is Allāh, your Lord, Creator of all things; there is no deity except Him, so how are you deluded?
tr: Dhālikumullāhu rabbukum khāliqu kulli shayʾ, lā ilāha illā huw, faʾannā tuʾfakūn

ar: كَذَٰلِكَ يُؤْفَكُ ٱلَّذِينَ كَانُوا۟ بِـَٔايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ يَجْحَدُونَ
en: (63) Thus were those [before you] deluded who were rejecting the signs of Allāh.
tr: Kadhālika yuʾfakul-ladhīna kānū biʾāyātillāhi yajḥadūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ قَرَارًا وَٱلسَّمَآءَ بِنَآءً وَصَوَّرَكُمْ فَأَحْسَنَ صُوَرَكُمْ وَرَزَقَكُم مِّنَ ٱلطَّيِّبَٰتِ ذَٰلِكُمُ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّكُمْ فَتَبَارَكَ ٱللَّهُ رَبُّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (64) It is Allāh who made for you the earth a place of settlement and the sky a structure [i.e., ceiling] and formed you and perfected your forms and provided you with good things. That is Allāh, your Lord; then blessed is Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
tr: Allāhul-ladhī jaʿala lakumul-arḍa qarāraw was-samāʾa bināʾaw waṣawwarakum faʾaḥsana ṣuwarakum warazaqakum minaṭ-ṭayyibāt, dhālikumullāhu rabbukum, fatabārakallāhu rabbul-ʿālamīn

ar: هُوَ ٱلْحَىُّ لَآ إِلَٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ فَٱدْعُوهُ مُخْلِصِينَ لَهُ ٱلدِّينَ ٱلْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ رَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (65) He is the Ever-Living;[1377] there is no deity except Him, so call upon Him, [being] sincere to Him in religion. [All] praise is [due] to Allāh, Lord of the worlds.
enNotes: [1377]- Whose life is without beginning or end, and upon whom all created life depends.
tr: Huwal-ḥayyu lā ilāha illā huwa fadʿūhu mukhliṣīna lahud-dīn, al-ḥamdu lillāhi rabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: قُلْ إِنِّى نُهِيتُ أَنْ أَعْبُدَ ٱلَّذِينَ تَدْعُونَ مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ لَمَّا جَآءَنِىَ ٱلْبَيِّنَٰتُ مِن رَّبِّى وَأُمِرْتُ أَنْ أُسْلِمَ لِرَبِّ ٱلْعَٰلَمِينَ
en: (66) Say, [O Muḥammad], "Indeed, I have been forbidden to worship those you call upon besides Allāh once the clear proofs have come to me from my Lord, and I have been commanded to submit to the Lord of the worlds."
tr: Qul innī nuhītu an aʿbudal-ladhīna tadʿūna min dūnillāhi lammā jāʾaniyal-bayyinātu mir rabbī waʾumirtu an uslima lirabbil-ʿālamīn

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى خَلَقَكُم مِّن تُرَابٍ ثُمَّ مِن نُّطْفَةٍ ثُمَّ مِنْ عَلَقَةٍ ثُمَّ يُخْرِجُكُمْ طِفْلًا ثُمَّ لِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَشُدَّكُمْ ثُمَّ لِتَكُونُوا۟ شُيُوخًا وَمِنكُم مَّن يُتَوَفَّىٰ مِن قَبْلُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوٓا۟ أَجَلًا مُّسَمًّى وَلَعَلَّكُمْ تَعْقِلُونَ
en: (67) It is He who created you from dust, then from a sperm-drop, then from a clinging clot; then He brings you out as a child; then [He develops you] that you reach your [time of] maturity, then [further] that you become elders. And among you is he who is taken in death before [that], so that you reach a specified term;[1378] and perhaps you will use reason.
enNotes: [1378]- The time decreed for your death.
tr: Huwal-ladhī khalaqakum min turābin thumma min nuṭfatin thumma min ʿalaqatin thumma yukhrijukum ṭiflan thumma litablughū ashuddakum thumma litakūnū shuyūkhā, waminkum may yutawaffā min qablu walitablughū ajalam musammaw walaʿallakum taʿqilūn

ar: هُوَ ٱلَّذِى يُحْىِۦ وَيُمِيتُ فَإِذَا قَضَىٰٓ أَمْرًا فَإِنَّمَا يَقُولُ لَهُۥ كُن فَيَكُونُ
en: (68) He it is who gives life and causes death; and when He decrees a matter, He but says to it, "Be," and it is.
tr: Huwal-ladhī yuḥyī wayumīt, faʾidhā qaḍā amran faʾinnamā yaqūlu lahū kun fayakūn

ar: أَلَمْ تَرَ إِلَى ٱلَّذِينَ يُجَٰدِلُونَ فِىٓ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ أَنَّىٰ يُصْرَفُونَ
en: (69) Do you not consider those who dispute concerning the signs of Allāh - how are they averted?
tr: Alam tara ilal-ladhīna yujādilūna fī āyātillāh, annā yuṣrafūn

ar: ٱلَّذِينَ كَذَّبُوا۟ بِٱلْكِتَٰبِ وَبِمَآ أَرْسَلْنَا بِهِۦ رُسُلَنَا فَسَوْفَ يَعْلَمُونَ
en: (70) Those who deny the Book [i.e., the Qur’ān] and that with which We sent Our messengers - they are going to know,
tr: Alladhīna kadhdhabū bil-kitābi wabimā arsalnā bihī rusulanā, fasawfa yaʿlamūn

ar: إِذِ ٱلْأَغْلَٰلُ فِىٓ أَعْنَٰقِهِمْ وَٱلسَّلَٰسِلُ يُسْحَبُونَ
en: (71) When the shackles are around their necks and the chains; they will be dragged
tr: Idhil-aghlālu fī aʿnāqihim was-salāsil, yusḥabūn

ar: فِى ٱلْحَمِيمِ ثُمَّ فِى ٱلنَّارِ يُسْجَرُونَ
en: (72) In boiling water; then in the Fire they will be filled [with flame].
tr: Fil-ḥamīmi thumma fin-nāri yusjarūn

ar: ثُمَّ قِيلَ لَهُمْ أَيْنَ مَا كُنتُمْ تُشْرِكُونَ
en: (73) Then it will be said to them, "Where is that which you used to associate [with Him in worship]
tr: Thumma qīla lahum ayna mā kuntum tushrikūn

ar: مِن دُونِ ٱللَّهِ قَالُوا۟ ضَلُّوا۟ عَنَّا بَل لَّمْ نَكُن نَّدْعُوا۟ مِن قَبْلُ شَيْـًٔا كَذَٰلِكَ يُضِلُّ ٱللَّهُ ٱلْكَٰفِرِينَ
en: (74) Other than Allāh?" They will say, "They have departed from us; rather, we did not used to invoke previously anything." Thus does Allāh put astray the disbelievers.
tr: Min dūnillāh, qālū ḍallū ʿannā bal lam nakun nadʿū min qablu shayʾā, kadhālika yuḍillullāhul-kāfirīn

ar: ذَٰلِكُم بِمَا كُنتُمْ تَفْرَحُونَ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ بِغَيْرِ ٱلْحَقِّ وَبِمَا كُنتُمْ تَمْرَحُونَ
en: (75) [The angels will say], "That was because you used to exult upon the earth without right and you used to behave insolently.
tr: Dhālikum bimā kuntum tafraḥūna fil-arḍi bighayril-ḥaqqi wabimā kuntum tamraḥūn

ar: ٱدْخُلُوٓا۟ أَبْوَٰبَ جَهَنَّمَ خَٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا فَبِئْسَ مَثْوَى ٱلْمُتَكَبِّرِينَ
en: (76) Enter the gates of Hell to abide eternally therein, and wretched is the residence of the arrogant."
tr: Udkhulū abwāba jahannama khālidīna fīhā, fabiʾsa mathwal-mutakabbirīn

ar: فَٱصْبِرْ إِنَّ وَعْدَ ٱللَّهِ حَقٌّ فَإِمَّا نُرِيَنَّكَ بَعْضَ ٱلَّذِى نَعِدُهُمْ أَوْ نَتَوَفَّيَنَّكَ فَإِلَيْنَا يُرْجَعُونَ
en: (77) So be patient, [O Muḥammad]; indeed, the promise of Allāh is truth. And whether We show you some of what We have promised them or We take you in death, it is to Us they will be returned.
tr: Faṣbir inna waʿdallāhi ḥaqq, faʾimmā nuriyannaka baʿḍal-ladhī naʿiduhum aw natawaffayannaka faʾilaynā yurjaʿūn

ar: وَلَقَدْ أَرْسَلْنَا رُسُلًا مِّن قَبْلِكَ مِنْهُم مَّن قَصَصْنَا عَلَيْكَ وَمِنْهُم مَّن لَّمْ نَقْصُصْ عَلَيْكَ وَمَا كَانَ لِرَسُولٍ أَن يَأْتِىَ بِـَٔايَةٍ إِلَّا بِإِذْنِ ٱللَّهِ فَإِذَا جَآءَ أَمْرُ ٱللَّهِ قُضِىَ بِٱلْحَقِّ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْمُبْطِلُونَ
en: (78) And We have already sent messengers before you. Among them are those [whose stories] We have related to you, and among them are those [whose stories] We have not related to you. And it was not for any messenger to bring a sign [or verse] except by permission of Allāh. So when the command of Allāh comes, it will be concluded [i.e., judged] in truth, and the falsifiers will thereupon lose [all].
tr: Walaqad arsalnā rusulam min qablika minhum man qaṣaṣnā ʿalayka waminhum mal lam naqṣuṣ ʿalayk, wamā kāna lirasūlin ay yaʾtiya biʾāyatin illā biʾidhnillāh, faʾidhā jāʾa amrullāhi quḍiya bil-ḥaqqi wakhasira hunālikal-mubṭilūn

ar: ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَنْعَٰمَ لِتَرْكَبُوا۟ مِنْهَا وَمِنْهَا تَأْكُلُونَ
en: (79) It is Allāh who made for you the grazing animals upon which you ride, and some of them you eat.
tr: Allāhul-ladhī jaʿala lakumul-anʿāma litarkabū minhā waminhā taʾkulūn

ar: وَلَكُمْ فِيهَا مَنَٰفِعُ وَلِتَبْلُغُوا۟ عَلَيْهَا حَاجَةً فِى صُدُورِكُمْ وَعَلَيْهَا وَعَلَى ٱلْفُلْكِ تُحْمَلُونَ
en: (80) And for you therein are [other] benefits and that you may realize upon them a need which is in your breasts;[1379] and upon them and upon ships you are carried.
enNotes: [1379]- i.e., that you may use the animals to carry your loads to distant places, according to need.
tr: Walakum fīhā manāfiʿu walitablughū ʿalayhā ḥājatan fī ṣudūrikum waʿalayhā waʿalal-fulki tuḥmalūn

ar: وَيُرِيكُمْ ءَايَٰتِهِۦ فَأَىَّ ءَايَٰتِ ٱللَّهِ تُنكِرُونَ
en: (81) And He shows you His signs. So which of the signs of Allāh do you deny?
tr: Wayurīkum āyātih, faʾayya āyātillāhi tunkirūn

ar: أَفَلَمْ يَسِيرُوا۟ فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَيَنظُرُوا۟ كَيْفَ كَانَ عَٰقِبَةُ ٱلَّذِينَ مِن قَبْلِهِمْ كَانُوٓا۟ أَكْثَرَ مِنْهُمْ وَأَشَدَّ قُوَّةً وَءَاثَارًا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ فَمَآ أَغْنَىٰ عَنْهُم مَّا كَانُوا۟ يَكْسِبُونَ
en: (82) Have they not traveled through the land and observed how was the end of those before them? They were more numerous than themselves and greater in strength and in impression on the land, but they were not availed by what they used to earn.
tr: Afalam yasīrū fil-arḍi fayanẓurū kayfa kāna ʿāqibatul-ladhīna min qablihim, kānū akthara minhum waʾashadda quwwataw waʾāthāran fil-arḍi famā aghnā ʿanhum mā kānū yaksibūn

ar: فَلَمَّا جَآءَتْهُمْ رُسُلُهُم بِٱلْبَيِّنَٰتِ فَرِحُوا۟ بِمَا عِندَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْعِلْمِ وَحَاقَ بِهِم مَّا كَانُوا۟ بِهِۦ يَسْتَهْزِءُونَ
en: (83) And when their messengers came to them with clear proofs, they [merely] rejoiced in what they had of knowledge, but they were enveloped by what they used to ridicule.
tr: Falammā jāʾathum rusuluhum bil-bayyināti fariḥū bimā ʿindahum minal-ʿilmi waḥāqa bihim mā kānū bihī yastahziʾūn

ar: فَلَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِٱللَّهِ وَحْدَهُۥ وَكَفَرْنَا بِمَا كُنَّا بِهِۦ مُشْرِكِينَ
en: (84) And when they saw Our punishment, they said, "We believe in Allāh alone and disbelieve in that which we used to associate with Him."
tr: Falammā raʾaw baʾsanā, qālū āmannā billāhi waḥdahū wakafarnā bimā kunnā bihī mushrikīn

ar: فَلَمْ يَكُ يَنفَعُهُمْ إِيمَٰنُهُمْ لَمَّا رَأَوْا۟ بَأْسَنَا سُنَّتَ ٱللَّهِ ٱلَّتِى قَدْ خَلَتْ فِى عِبَادِهِۦ وَخَسِرَ هُنَالِكَ ٱلْكَٰفِرُونَ
en: (85) But never did their faith benefit them once they saw Our punishment. [It is] the established way of Allāh which has preceded among His servants. And the disbelievers thereupon lost [all].
tr: Falam yaku yanfaʿuhum īmānuhum lammā raʾaw baʾsanā, sunnatallāhil-latī qad khalat fī ʿibādih, wakhasira hunālikal-kāfirūn
